patch.value: csv validate fails to register on pm-cli 2026.7.27 because it redeclares the host-owned --json global

pm-cli 2026.7.27 (GH-719) makes the host reject any extension command whose flags shadow a host-owned global. csv validate declared { long: "--json" }, so registerCommand threw and the command failed to register against a real host. The suite never caught it because every smoke test asserted against a hand-rolled api double that accepts all registrations unconditionally. Fix: drop the flag declaration, read ctx.global.json, and rebuild the smoke suite on the SDK createExtensionTestHarness so pm's real activation engine validates registration.

value.author: codex
value.text: Verified end-to-end in a throwaway workspace: pm install reports failed_count: 0; 'pm csv validate data.csv' and '--json' both work reading the host global; 'pm csv import' round-trips 2 real rows. Suite 105/105.
